chunks.text: Based on general Formula 1 knowledge rather than live race data, the Silver Arrows have a legendary history—from Juan Manuel Fangio's titles in 1954 and 1955 to winning eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021 in the turbo-hybrid era!

Drawing on general F1 knowledge, the Silver Arrows have a legendary history, starting with Juan Manuel Fangio winning back to back titles in 1954 and 1955. In the modern era, the team achieved an unprecedented eight consecutive Constructors Championships between 2014 and 2021, cementing their place as one of the greatest teams in the sport.
